dedupe_keys.name: niveau de frequentation maximale par ligne star

description: STAR describes maximum crowding observed during the preceding week on its Rennes transport lines. Fields identify transport mode, weekday group, line, time band, crowding label and numeric level. Levels are limited to 1, 2, 3 or blank. Blank may mean no information or no service, so it cannot be interpreted as zero demand. Weekday groups are Monday to Friday, Saturday and Sunday. These categorical observations can inform demand and crowding scenarios, but they are not passenger counts or measured vehicle capacity. The provider describes weekly updates, while the returned data-processing timestamp is July 2023. Present freshness is therefore unverified. A separate existing resource estimates maximum bus crowding for the current week. Coverage follows the provider-described Rennes network. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The source specifies ODbL licensing. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related current-week estimates describe projected line crowding.
